title: Customs and Compliance Operations Manager
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**


As the Customs \& Compliance Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), the role is responsible for ensuring Imports and Exports of shipments are executed adhering to Customs Regulatory compliance, mitigating customs risks, preventing penalties, and providing oversight of day\-to\-day customs operations across the APAC region including India. This includes ensuring that all customs activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable customs regulations, Pfizer policies, GDP/GMP standards, and local health authority requirements. The role also drives import/export process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives, leading projects to identify, mitigate, and remediate customs compliance risks while enhancing operational effectiveness and efficiency across the region.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Ensure customs compliance with local laws, customs regulations, and regulatory requirements across APAC.
* Manage import/export process including Drug Testing/sampling as required by local Authorities, and import duty payment process for importation into India and other APAC countries as assigned.
* Manage customs risks by identifying customs compliance gaps, operational vulnerabilities, and implementing corrective actions to mitigate any non\-compliance risks.
* Prevent customs penalties and violations through accurate customs administration and oversight.
* Liaise with Internal Stakeholders, Customs Brokers and Customs Authorities on customs\-related matters, customs audits and escalations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen compliance controls and customs processes.
* Ensure adherence to Pfizer SOPs, work instructions, and corporate values in all customs operations.
* Monitor customs performance and reporting, ensuring issues are identified, escalated, and addressed in a timely manner.
* Maintain processes that are compliance with GDP/GMP and local regulatory requirements to support the lawful movement of pharmaceutical products across the globe.
* Represent the region in global and regional forums;
* Given the nature of the role, calls outside of standard office hours may be required.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree
* **6\-10 years’ relevant work experience**
* **Strong knowledge on Customs Compliance operations and processes**
* **Direct involvement in managing Customs Audits**
* **Knowledge on Supply Chain and Logistics**
* Proficient in English (both verbal and writing) and other languages are a benefit
* Experience in managing complex issues independently and drive solutions to the problems with Stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Pharmaceutical / Life science industry
* Broad PC skills are essential (MS applications Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint)
* Profound knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems and other Data Analytic Tools.


Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.


To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI\-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

  


Logistics \& Supply Chain Mgmt

title: Senior Manager, System Operation and Administrator
description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Summary of This Role**
------------------------


Manages the operation, maintenance and administration of the organization's operating and management systems so that they function reliably, meet the organization's business needs, and use the organization's IT resources effectively. Oversees activities relating to technical guidance for planning, directing, and monitoring operating systems. Plans and recommends operating system modifications or additional equipment to increase the capacity of the system. Prepares operational cost estimates for current and proposed plans. Evaluates vendor proposals for purchases of hardware.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* Provides leadership for all aspects of a global multi\-data center environment. Coordinates the planning, acquisition, implementation, and support of systems deployed globally. Evaluates new technologies for optimal operational value and quality of service. Ensures compliance with regulatory and audit standards set forth by the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) No.16, Service Organization Controls Report (SOC1\), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), client contracts and other relevant standards. Ensures system security standards to protect customer data against unauthorized access.
* Plans and directs global capacity management activities to ensure systems are appropriately sized and configured to support customer needs. Establishes and supervises the collection of analytics used for capacity analysis to accurately forecast future resource utilization requirements. Produces annual capacity plan and contribute to budget development, to support required infrastructure enhancements. Ensures scalability and accessibility of applications or services.
* Leads infrastructure change process for a global card authorizations environment. Ensures that change is consistently\-executed, with no interruptions to service. Provides technical leadership of group incident resolution process and root cause analysis. Facilitates large changes and other high\-risk activity. Manages monitoring of other teams' changes when requested.
* Leads the development and support of a disaster recovery and business continuity solution, to support a critical business service. Evaluates new technology to decrease recovery times and simplify recovery solutions. Executes recovery of the production environment to an out of region facility, within contractual time frames.
* Facilitates vendor relationships with major hardware and software providers, including problem management, enhancements, and support. Monitors vendor performance, products, and services. Participates in vendor events which focus on future products and services, industry trends, vendor strategic direction and similar topics. Meets regularly with internal staff to keep apprised of strategic direction and how it would be supported by current and future vendor relationships.
* Collaborates and provides recommendations to executive leadership on technology related issues. Engages global internal business partners to understand their support needs and coordinate the development of infrastructure to maintain relevant services as the payments environment evolves. Communicates effectively with current and prospective clients to align business needs with technical solutions. Coaches team members to effectively engage clients and to provide industry\-best technical solutions.
* Not an exhaustive list; other duties as assigned.

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree, Relevant Experience or Degree in: related field of study from an accredited university is required; however, relevant experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
* Typically a minimum of 8 years related professional experience including a minimum of 3\-4 years experience in a supervisory position.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* None Identified

**What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?**
-------------------------------------------------

* Scope of Responsibility \- Responsibilities are often within a sub\-function or functional specialty.
* Planning Horizon \- Planning horizon is typically 1 year.
* Reporting Relationship \- Typically reports to a Director or Senior Director.
* Problem Solving Requirements \- Problems are sometimes broadly defined. Assistance from senior management is available if required.
* Span of Control Accountability \- Typically directly leads five or more supervisors, managers, higher level professional/technical team members, or lower to mid\-level senior professionals. Exercises full supervision in terms of staffing, work and performance management, salary decisions, training and development, and disciplinary issues.


Global Payments Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Global Payments provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by law. If you wish to request reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment or provide feedback about the accessibility of this website, please contact jobs@globalpayments.com.

title: Assistant Manager - Cloud & Security Network Operations & Support
description:
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
**Job Title:** F5 Load Balancer \- Level 3 Engineer


**Job Summary** **:**

We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. This role is crucial to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications delivered through F5 technologies. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.


**Responsibilities** **:**

* **F5 Load Balancer Administration:**
* + Implementation and manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM, ASM, APM modules).
	+ Develop and implement F5 profiles, rules and policies to meet business requirements.
	+ Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot F5 infrastructure to ensure uptime and reliability.
	+ Analyze logs and performance data to proactively identify and resolve issues.
	+ Implement health checks and failover strategies to ensure high availability of applications.
* **Firewall Administration:**
* + Network Security
	+ Manage Checkpoint/Cisco ASA firewalls
	+ Provide support for firewalls
* **Troubleshooting:**
* + Serve as the Level 3 (L3\) escalation point for resolving complex network and application\-related issues.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, traffic flow, and application performance issues involving F5 products.
* **Collaboration:**
* + Work closely with network engineers and application teams to ensure alignment on load balancing requirements.
	+ Collaborate on security compliance audits and assessments related to load balancing and traffic management.
* **Security:**
* + Implement security measures such as SSL offloading, web application firewalls (WAF), and DDoS protection on F5 devices.
	+ Stay updated on the latest security threats and ensure configurations are optimized to mitigate risks.
* **Documentation:**
* + Create and maintain documentation for F5 configurations, processes, and network architecture.
	+ Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to junior engineers or team members.
* **Automation \& Optimization:**
* + Automate routine tasks using F5 iControl REST API and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
	+ Propose improvements and optimization strategies for load balancing services.

**Requirements:**

* **Education:**
* + Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Experience:**
* + 6\+ years of hands\-on experience with F5 load balancers (BIG\-IP LTM, GTM, ASM, APM). Checkpoint or ASA firewalls.
	+ Proven expertise in designing and implementing advanced load balancing solutions.
	+ Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, DNS, and related technologies.
* **Skills:**
* + Proficiency in writing and debugging F5 iRules.
	+ Strong understanding of application traffic flows and troubleshooting techniques.
	+ Knowledge of network security principles, SSL certificates, and encryption methodologies. Firewall management
	+ Familiarity with other load balancers, firewalls, and web proxies is a plus.
	+ Familiarity with cloud\-based load balancing solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP).
	+ Experience with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins for infrastructure automation.
* **Soft Skills:**
* + Flexible to work according to requirements
	+ Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
	+ Strong communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
	+ Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or collaboratively.
* **Certifications:**
* + F5 Certified BIG\-IP Administrator (F5\-CA) or higher certification is preferred.
	+ CCNA/CCNP or other relevant network certifications are good to have.

title: Assistant Manager - IT Operations & Infrastructure
description:
### **Job Title: L2 Backup Engineer – Veeam \& Commvault**


### **Experience**



3–8 years in backup, storage, and data protection technologies


### **Role Summary**



The L2 Backup Engineer is responsible for supporting and managing enterprise backup environments using **Veeam** and **Commvault**. The role includes handling L2 incidents, troubleshooting backup and restore issues, ensuring data availability, and supporting disaster recovery processes across on\-prem and cloud environments.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Provide **L2 support** for backup incidents, service requests, and escalations from L1 teams
* Monitor and manage **daily backup jobs** across Veeam and Commvault platforms
* Troubleshoot **backup failures, job errors, performance issues, and restore failures**
* Perform **backup and restore operations** for virtual machines, databases, and file systems
* Manage **backup policies, schedules, retention, and replication configurations**
* Support **Disaster Recovery (DR) drills** and ensure adherence to RPO/RTO objectives
* Conduct **root cause analysis (RCA)** and implement preventive measures
* Perform **health checks, patching, and upgrades** of backup infrastructure
* Coordinate with **L3 teams and vendors** for major incidents and problem management
* Maintain **SOPs, runbooks, and operational documentation**
* Ensure compliance with **security, audit, and data retention policies**

### **Technical Skills Required**


### **Core Backup Skills**


* Hands\-on experience with: **Veeam Backup \& Replication**
* **Commvault (CommCell, Media Agent, Libraries)**


Strong understanding of:


* Backup types (Full, Incremental, Differential)
* Retention policies and lifecycle management
* RPO, RTO, and DR strategies

### **Infrastructure \& Platform Knowledge**


* Virtualization: **VMware / Hyper\-V**
* Operating Systems: Windows \& basic Linux
* Storage: SAN, NAS, Disk, Tape Libraries
* Networking fundamentals (firewall, ports, connectivity)

### **Required Skills**


* backup management
* commvault administration
* storage management
* backup and recovery
* storage area network
* network attached storage
* windows
* linux
* itsm

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

1\. Lead and oversee time and motion studies, process optimization and industrial engineering initiatives across press operations and allied processes.

2\. Drive line balancing, capacity planning and layout design to maximize throughput, eliminate bottlenecks and improve overall plant efficiency.

3\. Own and improve key operational metrics including OEE, cycle time, changeover time, downtime, and productivity.

4\. Design and implement optimal plant layouts, material flow systems, and ergonomic workstations to enhance safety and output.

5\. Champion the deployment of lean manufacturing tools such as 5S, Kaizen, SMED, Poka\-Yoke, VSM, and visual management across the shop floor.

6\. Monitor, analyze and report daily/weekly/monthly production, manpower utilization, and cost performance to senior leadership.

7\. Lead cross\-functional collaboration with Production, Maintenance, Quality and Supply Chain teams to execute continuous improvement and cost\-reduction projects.

8\. Develop and execute capacity planning, resource allocation, and manpower strategies to meet current and future order requirements.

9\. Identify and eliminate waste and non\-value\-added activities to drive significant cost savings and operational excellence.

10\. Build, mentor and manage the operations and industrial engineering team, setting clear goals and developing talent.

11\. Ensure strict adherence to safety, quality, and delivery standards while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

title: Operations Manager - Taloja
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Operations Management**
* Oversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning across inventory, production, and logistics.
* Develop, implement, and monitor operational strategies aligned with the company’s objectives.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and statutory regulations.
* **Inventory Management**
* Maintain accurate inventory records to prevent stock shortages or overstocking.
* Implement systems to track inventory levels and streamline the inventory cycle.
* Collaborate with procurement to forecast inventory needs based on production schedules and sales trends.
* Cold room handling
* **Production Oversight**
* Plan and coordinate production schedules to meet deadlines and quality standards.
* Optimize resource utilization, including manpower, machinery, and raw materials.
* Monitor production KPIs and implement continuous improvement measures.
* **Logistics Coordination**
* Oversee the planning and execution of inbound and outbound logistics operations.
* Establish and manage relationships with transport and warehousing partners.
* Ensure timely delivery to customers while minimizing logistics costs.
* **Team Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and train teams to enhance operational efficiency.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Resolve operational challenges promptly and effectively.
* **Process Improvement**
* Analyze operational workflows and implement process improvement initiatives.
* Leverage technology and tools to enhance productivity and efficiency.
* Monitor industry trends to incorporate best practices.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Educational Qualifications**:
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Operations/Logistics is preferred.
* **Work Experience**:
* 5\+ years of experience in operations management, with a strong background in inventory, production, and logistics.
* Prior experience in a manufacturing, retail, or supply chain environment is desirable.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* **Technical Skills**:
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g. VLOOKUP, pivot tables etc ) is must.
* Proficiency in inventory management software (e.g., SAP, Tally, or equivalent ERP systems) will be an added advantage
* Understanding of supply chain dynamics and lean manufacturing principles.
* **Leadership and Management**:
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
* **Other Competencies**:
* Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively under deadlines.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a drive for operational excellence.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a dynamic and growing organization.
* Opportunity to work on challenging projects and make a tangible impact.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.
